title: Announcements
description: What the cooperative tells its members, and the record of what was sent.
tableCaption: The cooperative's announcements, with their audience, state and how many messages each one sent.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Words in the title or the message

empty.title: No announcements yet
empty.body: Write one to tell the members about a meeting, a price or a delivery date. Most members are reached by SMS rather than by opening this.

fields.title: Title
fields.bodyHint: What the members will read. Keep it short: it is carried by SMS.
fields.bodyRwHint: Where you write one, this is what the members receive.
fields.audienceHint: Members are reached by SMS. A staff announcement is read here in the application.

form.addDescription: It is saved as a draft. Nothing is sent until you publish it.
form.editDescription: Only a draft can be changed. Once published, the record has to say what was sent.

publish.title: Publish this announcement?
publish.body: Publishing puts it on the cooperative's record. Sending it by SMS is a separate decision.
publish.withoutPhone_one: One member has no phone number and will not receive the message. Somebody will have to tell them.
publish.withoutPhone: {{count}} members have no phone number and will not receive the message. Somebody will have to tell them.
publish.cost_one: One message each, so {{messages}} in total.
publish.unicode: The text uses characters that make every message shorter and so more expensive.
publish.sendSms: Send it to the members by SMS
publish.sendSmsHint: Each message costs the cooperative. Leave this off to publish without sending.
publish.staffOnly: This announcement is for the staff, so it is read here and no messages are sent.
publish.mockBody: No SMS gateway is connected yet. Everything you send is written to the message log with its number and its text, and nothing reaches a telephone.

report.failedBody_one: One message was refused. The log says which member and why.
report.failedBody: {{count}} messages were refused. The log says which members and why.
report.alreadySent_one: One member had already been sent this announcement, so it was not sent again.
report.alreadySent: {{count}} members had already been sent this announcement, so it was not sent again.
report.withoutPhone_one: One member has no phone number and was not sent anything.
report.withoutPhone: {{count}} members have no phone number and were not sent anything.
report.mockBody: These messages were recorded and not delivered, because no SMS gateway is connected yet.

archive.title: Withdraw this announcement?
archive.body: It leaves the notice board and stays in the cooperative's record with the reason you give.
archive.bodySent_one: It has already been sent to one member, who cannot be un-told. It leaves the notice board and stays in the record with the reason you give.
archive.bodySent: It has already been sent to {{count}} members, who cannot be un-told. It leaves the notice board and stays in the record with the reason you give.

provider.mockBody: No SMS gateway is connected yet. Announcements you send are written to the message log and nothing reaches a telephone.

messages.title: Messages sent
messages.description: Every message the cooperative has sent its members, with who it went to and what happened.
messages.caption: Messages sent, with the member, the number, the text and the outcome.

empty.title: Nothing has been sent yet
empty.body: Publish an announcement to the members and every message appears here with its outcome.
